name: AI-assisted Capstone Project Assistant
description: University capstone projects require students to work with information from multiple sources, including general capstone guidance, project briefs, proposals, sponsor requirements, meeting outcomes, milestones, and other project documentation. As projects progress, this information can become distributed across different documents and communication channels, making it difficult for students and other project stakeholders to quickly locate and interpret information relevant to a particular project activity.
